hook: Same subject. One AI model. Five prompts. Five completely different results.
caption:
Same subject. One AI model. Five prompts. Five completely different results.

A single cat transformed through AI—from cute to horror to cinematic—just by changing the prompt. The visual difference is night and day, but it's all one model.

This is what most creators miss: the tool doesn't matter as much as the prompt. Every single aesthetic you see exists in one model. The difference is what you ask it to create.

Which aesthetic would you choose: cute, horror, or cinematic? 👇

Send this to someone who's been blaming their AI tool instead of improving their prompts.

Credit: @AriaWestcott on X
